post.caption: In June 1953 Jacqueline Bouvier told reporters she had no ring yet. That summer John F. Kennedy gave her a Van Cleef and Arpels ring with a 2.88 carat diamond beside a 2.84 carat emerald, a style called toi et moi, French for you and me. They married in Newport on September 12, 1953, and she had the ring reset with more diamonds in 1962.
